ownerAccountID.description: The payment link's owner's Moov account ID.

merchantPaymentMethodID.description: The merchant's preferred payment method ID. Must be a wallet payment method.

link.description: Link to the payment landing page for this payment link.

amount.description:
The fixed amount of the payment link.

In API versions before `2026.07.00`, this was a required field.

In API version `2026.07.00` and beyond, this field is present for `payment` and `payout` links and omitted
for `customAmountPayment` links, where the payor chooses the amount.

uses.description: The number of times this payment link has been used.

maxUses.description:
An optional limit on the number of times this payment link can be used.

**For payouts, `maxUses` is always 1.**

lastUsedOn.description: The timestamp when this payment link was last used.

expiresOn.description: An optional expiration date for this payment link.

ACHCompanyEntryDescription.description: An optional override of the default NACHA company entry description for a transfer.

ACHOriginatingCompanyName.description: An optional override of the default NACHA company name for a transfer.

ACHPaymentDetails.description: Options for payment links used to collect an ACH payment.

value.description:
Quantity in the smallest unit of the specified currency. 

In USD this is cents, for example, $12.04 is 1204 and $0.99 is 99.

valueDecimal.description:
A decimal-formatted numerical string that represents up to 9 decimal place precision. 

For example, $12.987654321 is '12.987654321'.

CallToAction.description:
The text to be displayed on web form's submit button.

If set to "auto" the UI will automatically select between 
"pay" and "confirm" for payments and payouts respectively.

CardDynamicDescriptor.description: An optional override of the default card statement descriptor for a transfer. Accounts must be enabled by Moov to set this field.

CardPaymentDetails.description: Options for payment links used to collect a card payment.

CollectionPaymentMethodType.description: Payment methods allowed for collecting a payment.

DisbursementPaymentMethodType.description: Payment methods allowed for disbursing funds.

ImageID.description: Unique identifier for a image resource.

ImagePublicID.description: A unique identifier for an image, used in public image links.

Mode.description: The operating mode for an account.

PaymentLinkCode.description: Unique code identifying this payment link.

requireAddress.description: If true, a billing address is required when completing the payment form.

requirePhone.description: If true, a phone number is required when completing the payment form.

metadata.description: Optional free-form metadata for the Moov account that will represent this customer.

title.description: The payment page title displayed to the user.

description.description: A payment description displayed to the user.

PaymentLinkDisplayOptions.description: Customizable display options for a payment link.

basePrice.description: The base price of the item before applying option modifiers.

options.description: Optional list of modifiers applied to this item (e.g., toppings, upgrades, customizations).

images.description: Optional list of images associated with this line item.

productID.description: Optional unique identifier associating the line item with a product.

PaymentLinkLineItem.description: Represents a single line item in a payment link, including optional modifiers and quantity.

name.description: The name of the option or modifier.

priceModifier.description: Optional price modification applied by this option. Can be positive, negative, or zero.

images.description: Optional list of images associated with this line item option.

group.description: Optional group identifier to categorize related options (e.g., 'toppings').

PaymentLinkLineItemOption.description: Represents a modifier or option applied to a line item.

PaymentLinkLineItems.description:
An optional collection of line items for a payment link.
When line items are provided, their total plus tax must equal the payment link amount.

allowedMethods.description: A list of payment methods that should be supported for this payment link.

metadata.description: Optional free-form metadata for the transfer.

PaymentLinkPaymentDetails.description: Options for payment links used to collect payment.

allowedMethods.description: A list of payment methods that should be supported for this payment link.

metadata.description: Optional free-form metadata for the transfer.

PaymentLinkPayoutDetails.description: Options for payout links used to send a payout.

PayoutRecipient.description:
Specify the intended recipient of the payout.
Either `email` or `phone` must be specified, but not both.

This information will be used to authenticate the end user when they follow the payment link.
